summary: Captures live audio channels from an input device using supported drivers such as system audio, ASIO, Blackmagic, or AJA.
key_concepts: Audio Device In CHOP captures live audio from an input device into CHOP channels.
Driver selects the backend, including system audio, ASIO, DataPath, Blackmagic, or AJA where supported.
Device selection can use the operating-system default recording device or an explicit available device.
Format and input-channel controls determine whether mono, stereo, or multichannel channels are created.
Rate and Buffer Length trade sample-rate control, latency, and capture stability.

key_params.name: errormissing
key_params.note: Raise an error if the selected device is missing

common_gotchas: Device names and driver availability are machine-specific; plans should handle missing devices explicitly.
Buffer length trades latency against stability.
Multichannel layouts require explicit channel mapping if downstream expects named speaker positions.
ASIO and professional capture drivers may have different sample-rate ownership than system audio.
